column3: gate cases whose retired gates read a traceback or a refusal on stderr: the ref is stdout and stderr as one stream, as the oracle prints them (row icon-the-116-silent-gate-cases-and-three-misnamed-ones-are-entries; Lon 2026-11-15 13:3x CST: an error from the oracle is an answer)
a program the oracle runs silent twice, whatever its stdin holds, is an entry graded by its exit status alone (Lon 2026-11-15 11:5x CST, in the grader window)

Lon 2026-11-17, in the cio window: "We are grading a compiler here, syntax/semantic/runtime errors." A program the oracle translator refuses the same way on two runs is an entry: its answer is what the translator printed (stderr merged) and its want_rc the translator status, so SCRIP must give the same refusal (row icon-the-116-silent-gate-cases-and-three-misnamed-ones-are-entries).

Icon's pathload (ipl io.icn) finds libcfunc.so on FPATH; the library is the oracle's own build for the box (never built by SCRIP's make or by a run), the same line arizona_tests carries (row icon-the-116-silent-gate-cases-and-three-misnamed-ones-are-entries)
